title: Mixed Hodge Modules and Canonical Perverse Extensions for Multi-Node Conifold Degenerations
summary: We study one-parameter conifold degenerations whose central fiber has finitely many ordinary double points and construct a mixed-Hodge-module refinement of the canonical corrected perverse object associated with the degeneration. We build a rank-one point-supported mixed-Hodge-module block at each node, identify the global singular quotient as $\bigoplus_{k=1}^r i_{k*}\Q^H_{\{p_k\}}(-1)$, and assemble these local blocks via Saito's divisor-case gluing formalism into a global object $\mathcal P^H \in MHM(X_0)$.
